Use a retrieval setup that attaches temporal validity to each retrieved item and filters or down-weights items that are no longer valid. One option is NuggetIndex, which stores atomic records with evidence links, a temporal validity interval, and a lifecycle state, then filters invalid or deprecated nuggets before ranking [8]. Another is Chronofy, which embeds temporal validity into representation, retrieval, and reasoning using temporal decay and explicit validity checks [4].

If you want a simpler ranking-focused approach, a recency-aware hybrid re-ranker can reduce stale-document poisoning when date metadata is reliable, but performance depends on accurate temporal metadata [1]. For time-sensitive news, DynaTree adapts retrieval over time and improves freshness and relevance in a live system [7].
